about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Eric Schmitt

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HOUSE BILLS
statements.title: HOUSE BILLS
sentences: Notwithstanding rule XXII, I ask unanimous consent that the Senate proceed to the immediate consideration of the following bills en bloc: Calendar No. 617, H.R. 8454, Ackerson Meadow Land Exchange; and Calendar No. 662, H.R. 5254, Gateway Partnership Act.
That is why I introduced the Gateway Partnership Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SURVIVOR JUSTICE TAX PREVENTION ACT
statements.title: SURVIVOR JUSTICE TAX PREVENTION ACT
sentences: Since the authorization and the Working Families Tax Cut, a little over a year ago, 70 percent of copper wire has been replaced with fiber, nearly 470 radios converted to modernized systems, new electronic flight strips installed in 25 control towers, 220-plus new IP voice switches in place.
The Modern Skies Act, which I introduced months ago, would invest $30 billion to finish that work, building on the $12.5 billion downpayment already made through the Working Families Tax Cut.
We cannot accept their continued deterioration.
That is why I introduced the Modern Skies Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TAXPAYER ASSISTANCE AND SERVICE ACT
statements.title: TAXPAYER ASSISTANCE AND SERVICE ACT
sentences: Just last week, we saw that one health insurance marketplace had over 700,000 fraudsters and over $2 billion in fraud.
For years, as government spending boomed, this theft from the American people was treated as a cost of doing business.

To address this problem, we need a permanent National Fraud Enforcement Division that brings together prosecutors, investigators, Federal Agencies, and State and local law enforcement to attack fraud on the frontlines.
During the prior administration, fentanyl and other dangerous drugs poured across Joe Biden's open borders.
Cartel members poured across the open border as well and victimized the American people with violent crime, human trafficking, and dangerous drugs.
In Missouri, the consequences of that open border were all too real.
President Trump ran on closing the border and stopping the flow of these dangerous drugs.
That model incorporates FBI and DHS agents alongside the more than 20 Federal Agencies and over 400 State, local, and international law enforcement agencies for coordinated operations.
The reorganization sought to go upstream and get to the source of the true problem, securing the border and stopping the cartels and other transnational criminal organizations.

By focusing on the actual root of the problem through the Homeland Security Task Force model, we have seen investigators, prosecutors, intelligence analysts, and immigration enforcement working together to disrupt the cartels and the criminal networks threatening our country.

By updating our law enforcement model to meet the reality on the ground and the realities of modern transnational criminal threats, the new Homeland Security Task Force model has achieved remarkable success.
Our intelligence Agencies have reported that fentanyl crossing the border fell 55 percent after President Trump took office.
And the new Homeland Security task forces have arrested thousands of criminals, including more than a thousand cartel members, hundreds of MS-13 gang members, and hundreds of Tren de Aragua members.

They have seized tons of illegal drugs, including more than 300,000 fentanyl pills, and they have taken thousands of illegal guns off the streets as well from hardened gang members and cartel members.
Law enforcement agents have worked tirelessly over the past few decades to try to stem the tide of transnational organized crime and criminal gangs.
The Trump administration inherited the status quo with dedicated law enforcement agents but an organizational and operational model that wasn't working.
President Trump's reorganization efforts broke that mold, and it proved to be one of the most important steps we have ever taken against the cartels.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: It rewards the athlete who played, stayed, developed, and became a leader in that locker room.
The Sports Broadcasting Act in title II of this gives schools another option.
But the way it has played out, the only entity literally on planet Earth that can grant the limited antitrust protection status for the NCAA to enforce rules is Congress.
This thing that we get to enjoy right now on a Saturday afternoon when the Florida Gators come to Missouri this Saturday--and I will be there--is unlike anything that exists anywhere.
If we get this thing done, we will see how this plays out, but at least the option exists.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Protect College Sports Act of 2026 (Executive Calendar)
statements.title: Protect College Sports Act of 2026 (Executive Calendar)
sentences: It is to grant limited antitrust exemption status for a governing body, the NCAA, to enforce rules; meaning, 5 years of eligibility.
But if this stuff is challenged, they have no legal ability, because of our antitrust laws, to actually enforce these rules.
So we are giving that limited antitrust protection to enforce eligibility in 5 years, to enforce the one-time transfer.
Now, I will tell you that maybe the one group that doesn't like this is the sports agents--the rich sports agents who wear Gucci suits and alligator shoes.

And while we are talking about it--because I am sure you are going to hear some criticisms from some people who are going to use some pretty--well, I will let them speak for themselves the language they are going to use about this.
We are going to get one shot at this.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Mr. President, reserving the right to object, I object to this mass amnesty bill.
Last week, Democrats asked the Senate to extend Haitian temporary protected status.
But that is how Democrats do mass amnesty.
When the American people finally elect a President to end this chaos, to end this abuse, Democrats demand mass amnesty.
Yet Democrats want to erase the removal, reopen the border, and bring that person back with a green card.
The bill even threatens penalties against law enforcement who properly use the information.
Republicans want to handcuff illegal criminals; Democrats want to handcuff law enforcement officers so they can't do their jobs.
Why are illegal aliens more important to them now than protecting American citizens?
Today, they demand permanent residency for all--permanent residency for people who already left, legal shields against law enforcement, and more ammunition for activist lawsuits.
Foreign nationals do not have a right to permanent settlement here.
Today, I am objecting to this Democrat attempt to give millions of illegal aliens mass amnesty, green cards, and work authorizations.
I will always object to this mass amnesty.
I will always object to tying the hands of our law enforcement.
I reject all of that completely, in public, for the world to see, because I stand by my brothers and sisters of this country.
I will always object to this mass migration.
I will always object to putting American workers last.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DECLARATION OF INDEPENDENCE REAFFIRMATION ACT OF 2026
statements.title: DECLARATION OF INDEPENDENCE REAFFIRMATION ACT OF 2026
sentences: It is the first great act of an American union.
That is why I rise today in support of repassing the Declaration of Independence.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SECURE AMERICA ACT
statements.title: SECURE AMERICA ACT
sentences: There was a time when Democrat Presidents actually gave speeches about our border and making sure that we deported people who were here illegally.
The Democrats have made their central plank of everything that they hold onto in this town about open borders, mass migration, and anti-law enforcement.
We saw this iteration with the ``defund the police'' movement.
It simply gravitated to the ``defund ICE'' movement.
And the Democrats, they can talk all day long about how they don't want to deport criminal illegal aliens, because that is really what this is about.
For years, Washington treated immigration as a border issue alone.
Illegal aliens do not stay at the border.
Since 2010, the median age of the first-time home buyer in this country has gone from 30 years old to 40 years old.
The median downpayment for a first-home buyer now is more than $40,000.
Deporting 10 million illegal aliens would save American taxpayers at least a half a trillion dollars.
That money could be used and should be used to strengthen American households, schools, hospitals, police departments, and our neighborhoods.
Sanctuary politicians attacked immigration enforcement, declared themselves morally superior, and watched their budgets buckle.
That is the sanctuary city model: benefits for illegal aliens, fiscal strain for citizens, and moral vanity masquerading as compassion.
It opened the border in the name of an ideology that treats America like a labor market with a flag attached to it.

Now, for the first time in a generation, we have a chance to choose something different--to secure the border, to carry out these deportations, to restore sanity to the labor market, to bring down housing demand, to put American taxpayers first, and to rebuild an economy that serves the American people once again.
I won't even get into the idea of what a departure from the norms this has been, for a policy reason, to hold up an appropriation, but that is what happened.
It is about whether this Nation remains a home for its very own people and whether we are going to fight to make sure America remains a home for Americans.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Mr. President, I rise again on this pressing matter of funding law enforcement, and the stakes couldn't be higher.
Democrats blocked full funding for border security and deportations.
This time, we will finish what the American people elected us to do--enforce our immigration laws and deport those who defy them, because this is not just another spending debate.
Then came the 4-year invasion, 15 million illegal immigrants flooding across our border--criminals, rapists, murderers.
We have seen individuals from over 100 countries cross our borders--cartels, traffickers, and foreign adversaries ready to exploit weakness.
Without enforcement, our southern border becomes a superhighway for cartels, crime, drugs, and terror.
Our Nation has language, a memory, a border, and a people with the sovereign right to decide who gets to join them.
It runs like a river of sin cutting through our land--murder, rape, arson, torture.

Innocent Americans--daughters, sons, families--lost because the law was not enforced before the crime; lost because the Democrats have chosen illegal aliens over their fellow citizens, a choice made time and time again by the Democrats.
When given the choice between funding deportations and protecting sanctuary jurisdictions, Democrats chose sanctuary jurisdictions.
When given the choice between American citizens and illegal aliens, Democrats chose illegal aliens, and the human cost of that decision is staggering.
The destiny of the American Nation is not to manifest death and destruction upon its own people through lawlessness and subversion of law enforcement.
We will not defund law enforcement as Democrats argue for.
That means ending sanctuary policies that shield criminal illegal aliens.
It means cutting off the incentives that fuel illegal immigration.
To my Democrat colleagues, the American people rejected your open borders agenda.
They voted for the deportations law enforcement will deliver.

We will not let America become a place where citizenship means nothing, where borders mean nothing, where the good and the heroic people who built this country are treated as enemies, while politicians refuse to notify law enforcement when a criminal illegal alien is being released from prison and into our communities.
Now, we return with reconciliation as our vehicle, and we will not fail.
We will not accept a system where action only comes after an American's blood is spilled on American soil.
We will not force our agents to do more with less while anarchy spreads like a plague.
And we will not accept the lie that enforcement must always be delayed, diluted, or denied.
We are going to restore order.
I reject that future and so do the American people.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Mr. President, the bill in the Chamber well right now does one simple thing: It gives U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement stable, long-term funding so it can do the job the Congress assigned it to do--enforce the immigration laws on the books and protect the American people.
They could not persuade the American people to support amnesty for millions of illegal aliens who poured into this country under the Biden Presidency.
They could not stop President Trump from closing the border.

They say they only want to deport the worst of the worst, but if that were true, they would not be trying to weaken the very Agency responsible for finding, detaining, and removing criminal illegal aliens.
We are not going to abolish ICE by a budgetary gimmick.
We are not going to force the Agency to do more with less while the left expands sanctuary policies, wages lawfare against deportation, and turns enforcement into a political target.

It looks like Laken Riley; it looks like Stephanie Minter; it looks like Sheridan Gorman; it looks like Katie Abraham--Americans whose lives cannot be restored after the fact because Washington refused to enforce the law before the next crime was committed.
It says that the answer to a border invasion is not performative outrage followed by bureaucratic surrender; the answer is enforcement.
We will be back in reconciliation, where 50-plus-1 votes are enough and the filibuster cannot save you.

By the way, if we are going to do another reconciliation bill, I may want to do something more than budgetary measures to help ICE do its job, like defunding sanctuary cities or removing the financial incentives for illegal immigration.
They see exactly who is standing in the way of law enforcement and public safety, and they are not going to forget it.
But either today or through reconciliation, we will fully fund ICE.
My bill says plainly we are not going to let that happen.

We are not going to accept the lie that immigration enforcement should begin only when an illegal alien has already committed a violent crime in this country because by then, for some American families, it is already too late.
We will be back to deliver the funding for ICE needs, and we will be back to deliver the policy changes the American people are demanding.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026--Motion to Proceed
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026--Motion to Proceed
sentences: Mr. President, the horrific murder in Chicago last week has reminded this Nation that the battle to defend the American people, strengthen our Republic, and yield constitutional authority for the common good is not confined to the southern border.
Sanctuary cities are not a polite exercise of State sovereignty or some virtue of federalism.
Sanctuary cities are a declaration that illegal aliens' lives matter but American citizens' lives do not.
But last week she was murdered in cold blood by an illegal alien from Venezuela.

She was killed, her life taken from her and a daughter stolen from her family by a criminal illegal alien who would not have been in this country but for the Democrats' open border and sanctuary city policies.
Border Patrol caught him in May of 2023.
The Biden administration's open border policies let him go.
But Illinois and Chicago's sanctuary policies ordered the police to say nothing to ICE.
That illegal alien was previously in law enforcement's custody twice, and both times radical Democrat policies released him back onto the streets to prey on the American citizenry.
It is uncomfortable for Democrats to confront the reality that their policies and radical ideology are causing preventable murders of American sons and daughters at the hands of illegal aliens.

No, the only person who was in the wrong place at the wrong time was the illegal alien murderer whose very presence in the country was the direct result of Democrat open border policies and sanctuary jurisdiction policies.
And if those policies had not existed, he would have been back in Venezuela years ago.

Rather than admit this sanctuary city policy caused the preventable murder, Illinois Governor JB Pritzker released a statement saying that ``Republicans need to stop politicizing heinous tragedies.'' What an ugly, revealing statement.
Sanctuary policies are getting American citizens killed.
The truth is, sanctuary cities force us to confront a test, the most fundamental test of any government: Does it still understand its first and only real obligation is to protect its own citizens?
They have chosen an open border's ideology over the American Nation.
At root, the scourge of sanctuary cities forces us to answer the same question as the SAVE America Act: Who or what comes first?
Is it the American people, American sons and daughters, or is it illegal aliens and this radical open borders ideology?
Not in theory, not in slogans, but in practice--when the handcuffs go on, when the phone call to federal law enforcement is made or not made, when lives hang in the balance.
If the answer is not the American citizen, if the answer is not Sheridan Gorman or Laken Riley or Stephanie Minter or Katie Abraham, then we are no longer arguing about immigration policy.
Democrats value illegal aliens more than Americans.
This idea, this toxic empathy, this suicidal empathy to placate the left is driving this debate we are having right now where they don't want to fund Federal law enforcement.
They would rather a sanctuary jurisdiction not tell ICE that a murderer or a rapist is being released from prison to be deported.
I litigated with Democrats on title 42 and ``Remain in Mexico.'' Deep down in the DNA now is something that has been lost.

By failing to give illegal aliens a pathway to citizenship, this Democrat noted that ``we failed to deliver for the people we care about the most, undocumented migrants.'' The people Democrats care about most are not you or your family.
Instead, it is Jose Medina-Medina and the 15 million other illegal immigrants that the Biden administration let into this country.
Democrats right now value illegal aliens more than traveling Americans.
They value illegal aliens more than the American families hit by a disaster.
They value illegal aliens more than Sheridan Gorman, Laken Riley, Stephanie Minter, or Katie Abraham.
That is why they have built sanctuary cities in Chicago, in New Orleans, in Los Angeles, in Minneapolis.

As a Senator from Missouri, where we still believe the first job of government is to keep Missouri families safe, I say this plainly: Prioritizing illegal aliens to American citizens is unacceptable, and it is downright un-American.
Prioritize the safety of American citizens over ideology and illegal aliens because at the end of the day, this is not about ideology or politics.
We will not let this be memory-holed as ``wrong place, wrong time.'' This was a violent, preventable act, enabled by radical policies that put illegal aliens ahead of American citizens.
End sanctuary cities once and for all.
If we cannot agree to affirm all those principles, then we are drifting, slowly but unmistakably, away from the principles that sustain a free and ordered society.
I want to close by reading part of a statement from the Gorman family: We will not allow this to be dismissed as wrong place, wrong time.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SAFEGUARD AMERICAN VOTER ELIGIBILITY ACT--Resumed
statements.title: SAFEGUARD AMERICAN VOTER ELIGIBILITY ACT--Resumed
sentences: The first is the funding of DHS, and the second will be on the SAVE America Act.
They want the facial recognition software that exists on Facebook and others, when people are doxed, to be very clear and usable so that nobody wants to join ICE anymore.
This is the exact same phenomena that happened with the ``defund the police'' movement.
What happened was because the police officers were demonized by the left, people retired early.
People stopped joining police departments.
That is not good enough because they want to make it harder to deport people.

I think they want to create a dynamic like they did with the ``defund the police'' movement that they were so supportive of a decade ago with the defund ICE movement so that they can't do their jobs and their jobs become so difficult and their families are terrorized that nobody wants to be an ICE agent anymore.
You have amnesty for the 15 million people who are here illegally, de facto amnesty because they are not going to be deported.

S. 1383 Mr. President, I also point out, as we talk about the SAVE America Act, the graveyards of history are littered with the bones of once great republics that chose to die, not because foreign armies stormed their gates in a single dramatic assault, but because their own leaders slowly, deliberately, and cowardly surrendered the thing that made them nations in the first place.

The SAVE America Act before us is not three unrelated titles; it is one urgent existential question: Will America still have the will to live or do we join the long list of civilizations that quietly chose decline?
We just endured 4 years of the wildest open border in American history.
Now, those same Democrats have the audacity to claim that simply asking people to prove that they are American citizens before they register to vote is somehow voter suppression.
When I was Missouri's attorney general, I stood in court and fought the left's dark money lawyers to defend these very safeguards.
Next comes the surrender of truth--title II of the SAVE American Sports provision of this underlying substitute.
Title II simply says what every normal American already knows: Women's and girls' sports are for women and girls.
Biological males cannot declare themselves women and steal scholarships, records, locker rooms, and safety from actual females.
We have watched this fraud unfold in realtime--boys with superior strength and bone density dominating girls' competitions while the ruling class calls it inclusion.
A nation that tells its own daughters they must accept boys in their locker rooms has already lost the will to tell the truth about anything.
It says that confused children do not need scalpels, cross-sex hormones, or lifelong medical dependency.

What the other side calls ``gender-affirming care'' is nothing less than a profit-driven scandal, and Big Pharma and activist doctors turn childhood confusion into permanent patients and permanent revenue streams.
Democrats are not debating this legislation because they cannot defend what this bill exposes--open borders and open season on America's daughters and children.

Working families in Missouri and across this Nation are done--done with citizenship being treated like a suggestion, done with their daughters being erased in the name of inclusion, done with their children being targeted by an ideology that profits from permanent harm.
Mr. President, I am going to address two issues.
So this fundamental question about whether or not we are going to get funding for DHS is going to be very hard to solve when the Democrats on the other side don't actually want to solve the problem.
And so as far as I am concerned, we are not going to do anything that kneecaps ICE's ability to do their jobs.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SAFEGUARD AMERICAN VOTER ELIGIBILITY ACT--Continued
statements.title: SAFEGUARD AMERICAN VOTER ELIGIBILITY ACT--Continued
sentences: Department of Homeland Security Mr. President, I would also--before I talk about the SAVE Act, I just want to point out how the Democrats at this point, time and time again, have refused to fund the Department of Homeland Security at a time where we have conflict, at a time where we have seen terrorist attacks on the homeland--whether it is in Austin, Old Dominion, in Michigan--through the disastrous immigration policy overseen by the Biden administration with the Democrats where 15 million people came in here illegally, many of which we have no idea who they are.
And the Democrats hate ICE and want to defund ICE so much they are willing to endanger the lives of the American people for this showboating and grandstanding.

This is a wildly bizarre, out-of-step ideology at this point where open borders is now in their DNA, and their refusal to want to get rid of people who shouldn't be here in the first place and prioritizing people who are here illegally over American citizens is nuts.

S. 1383 Mr. President, which leads me to the SAVE Act, the SAVE America Act, this is about making sure that American elections are for Americans and also protecting women and girls from having men participating in their sports and children being mutilated and offered up at the altar of a radical ideology.
Yesterday, Democrats unleashed a coordinated barrage of lies about this amendment, this amendment that I have, the substitute amendment, the SAVE America Act.
The SAVE America Act has three clear claims, this amendment that is pending: Title I, SAVE American Voters restores integrity to our Federal elections.

It requires proof of citizenship to register to vote, requires voter identification, makes in-person voting the rule for able-bodied Americans, while preserving absentee ballots for our military, individuals with disabilities, caregivers, those who are sick, those who are even traveling, and verified hardship cases that the State can determine.
Title II, SAVE American Sports, defends biology and biological reality in women's and girls sports.
This bill targets only fraudulent and illegal voters, noncitizens who have no right to our ballot and cheaters who refuse even the most basic safeguards of lawful voting.

If my Democrat colleagues want to stand here and suggest that requiring citizenship and voter ID somehow threatens their political coalition, they are free to make that argument, but maybe you are protesting just a little bit too much.
The Democrats claim that voters will have to show up to the polls carrying proof of citizenship.
Noncitizens don't get to vote.
My Democrat colleagues have pulled a five- alarm fire because this bill asks people to simply attest that they are U.S. citizens when they newly register to vote here.
And spoiler alert for my Democrat colleagues: Federal law already requires applicants to attest that they are citizens when they register to vote.
Mr. President, 52 USC section 20508(b)(2) requires the Federal voter registration form to include a statement that includes citizenship.
I have seen a clip recently of the minority leader begging for fraud protections, begging that photo ID be presented when people vote.
The Democrat Party has been completely radicalized and believes that illegal immigrants should be able to come here, never have to leave, and now vote in our elections.
They claim it abolishes absentee voting.

This bill actually does preserve absentee voting for Americans with real needs: our military members, the disabled, caregivers, and verified hardship cases--those who are sick, those who are traveling, and others.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SAFEGUARD AMERICAN VOTER ELIGIBILITY ACT
statements.title: SAFEGUARD AMERICAN VOTER ELIGIBILITY ACT
sentences: That is why I rise in support of my substitute amendment to the SAVE America Act, and it comes before us at a fitting hour in our Nation's life.
Title II, Save American Sports, says that women's sports exist for women and girls, acknowledging biological reality over a legal fiction imposed by elite ideology.
Let me begin with title I. A republic has the right to distinguish citizens from noncitizens.
That is why requiring proof of citizenship to vote in Federal elections is foundational.
The same is true for voter identification.
That is why over 80 percent of American voters support voter ID.
Identity verification is ordinary in every serious sphere of life.

The Carter-Baker Commission, formed by former Democrat President Jimmy Carter and former Republican Secretary of State James Baker III, made many of the recommendations that my amendment promotes: voter ID, proof of citizenship, and limiting mail- in balloting.
Seventy-one percent of self-identified Democrats support voter ID.
When I served as Missouri's attorney general, I fought in court and defended our State's election integrity laws against a coordinated assault from the left in 2020.

The left's dark money-funded election superlawyers did not merely challenge one rule here or there; they challenged the very idea that we can get serious rules to protect the ballot, deter fraud, preserve order, and sustain public confidence in the vote.

That fight has taught me something I have never forgotten: The fight over election integrity is about more than mechanics or procedure; rather, it is about whether we still have the moral confidence to defend the elementary conditions of self-government--because once every safeguard is treated as suspect, once every verification measure is denounced as oppression, once every effort to secure the ballot is caricatured as hostility to democracy, what is really under attack is the public's faith that elections are fair, lawful, and real.
So when I speak today about voter ID, proof of citizenship, and limits on mass mail voting, I do so from experience.
That is what title II is trying to do.
The SAVE America Act is the defense of the elementary truths on which republican life--small ``r''--still depends: America belongs to its citizens.
The Senate should act, and the SAVE America Act should pass.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026--Motion to Proceed
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026--Motion to Proceed
sentences: To my Democrat colleagues: If you have a bill that you want to defund ICE with, put it on the floor.

What this is really about is the Democrats lost an election where the issue of border enforcement and deportations were on the table, front and center in front of the voters, and the voters supported it.

And to make that clear, Joe Biden and the Democrats let 15 million people in here illegally, tens of thousands of murderers, hundreds of thousands of violent criminals, and now that same party wants to defund the Agency that is charged with deporting these monsters.
I choose to support law enforcement.
I am not going to go along with the idea that we are going to give the Democrats the ability to kneecap ICE so they can get amnesty by lack of enforcement.
The language being used on this floor to describe Federal law enforcement--Nazis, the Gestapo.
And I will tell you that I have great appreciation for the men and women who go into very dangerous situations to deport criminals who want to rape and murder our fellow citizens.

So five reasons why I cannot go along with this scam: Laken Riley, Jocelyn Nungaray, Kayla Hamilton, Dacara Thompson, and Hallie Helgeson--all Americans--all murdered by illegal aliens released by Democrats, instead of being deported.
There are nine sanctuary jurisdictions in this country that, actually, probably are significant.
In those nine sanctuary jurisdictions, there is a 590-percent increase for anti-ICE attacks.
One more thing that is out of control: sanctuary jurisdictions at large.
And for the friends watching at home, what is a sanctuary jurisdiction that the Democrats are so proud of?
They are local jurisdictions that will not tell Federal law enforcement when an illegal alien rapist or murderer is being released from prison.
That is what we are fighting against, and we are not going to allow them to kneecap our Federal law enforcement from getting these monsters out of our country.
They want to undermine law enforcement and give blanket amnesty to 15 million people here illegally.
We are not going to let you get to that result by way of holding everyone else hostage.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: And let me be clear: We are going to do nothing--nothing--that kneecaps ICE's ability to enforce our immigration laws, because there were no Democrats out here that wept or pointed out that Jocelyn Nungaray, the 12-year-old girl, was kidnapped, raped, and murdered by two illegal aliens in 2024.
There was nobody out here talking about Laken Riley.
Now, what we have heard from the new Democrat Governor in Virginia is that they are going to be a sanctuary jurisdiction, and they are not going to work with ICE.
They are not going to--actually, on the guy who stabbed a woman to death at a bus stop, they are not going to let ICE know when that person is released from prison or jail.
This question about deporting illegal immigrants was on the ballot.
It was on the ballot, and the American people supported the idea that we were going to deport people--we were going to use our Federal law enforcement to deport people.
They don't like that, and so the way that they get at mass amnesty now is not passing a law, because they can't do that.
You want to prolong this until you get another incident, while your activists are on the streets confronting ICE agents in sanctuary jurisdictions, hoping they get some viral moment.

But the truth is, all of the incidents that you can really count on, that you can point to that any confrontation happened with ICE agents are in sanctuary jurisdictions where they don't respond to 911 calls for ICE agents, and they don't cooperate with ICE agents.
It is very easy for an ICE agent to show up at a penitentiary or a jail or prison and get somebody and deport them.
You have done an incredible job, Leader, of saying: We are going to get back to regular order.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026--Motion to Proceed--Resumed
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026--Motion to Proceed--Resumed
sentences: Right about now, there is a bus leaving.
There is a bus leaving the Capitol grounds and headed for an airport.

Democrats are on that bus who just voted to defund the paycheck of the TSA agent making $40,000 a year, to hop on a plane, funded by your tax dollars, to go to Munich, to go to Europe, and badmouth American foreign policy.
But outside of the foreign policy debate, just how offensive is it that they voted to defund DHS and are going to fly transatlantic on the taxpayer dime and trash talk America.
This is a 10-year struggle for commonsense Americans who have pushed back against a radical open borders policy that has been pushed by the Democrats.

President Trump won in 2016 on a few issues, but the electrical cord that began when he came down the escalator, that continues to this day, is taking on illegal immigration and the forgotten men and women of this country whose jobs were initially displaced when the failed policies of the politicians of this town sent their jobs overseas--the towns that I grew up in--and then when they were looking for new jobs, their wages were suppressed, and their jobs went to illegal immigrants.
The left has tried to destroy this country through this open borders policy because we are all citizens of the world.
Thank God we front-loaded in the Working Families Tax Cut money for deportations and tens of billions for detention centers.
Joe Biden opened up our border.

They have lost the argument with American citizens, and they think that if they flood this country with illegal immigrants--and by the way, you shouldn't have to prove you are an American citizen to vote.
You shouldn't have to show photo ID, which is broadly supported even among Democrat voters.
Even though their voters don't want that, even though their voters want photo ID to be established when you vote, why would they be opposed to that?
Because they want people who shouldn't be able to vote--illegal immigrants or fraudsters--to vote for them.

statements.title: Nominations (Executive Calendar)
sentences: As our Founders envisioned what our system of government looked like, they wanted something that was very different than the House and something that you had equal representation as opposed to proportional representation, this system of checks and balances in a bicameral legislature, every State, no matter the size, having two Senators was thought of very differently and has proven over the course of our nearly 250 years to be a very important place to protect individual rights and a whole host of other issues that matter to the American people.

To take a step back for the folks watching on C-SPAN, for the folks in the Gallery, for over 200 years--for over 200 years--the Executive Calendar, which is what we are dealing with today and what this whole debate is about--this Executive Calendar, there was no filibuster ever.
But to put this in perspective, the folks nominated as judges for the Cabinet and other related posts--judges, for example, weren't even really subject to the filibuster.
Think about this, Clarence Thomas, perhaps one of the most controversial Supreme Court Justices--or that nomination was--got 52 votes.
A filibuster wasn't instituted on Clarence Thomas--52 votes and he was confirmed.
Any Senator could have moved forward with an effort to filibuster, requiring cloture, and then a vote requiring 60 votes.
So they decided to change things around here, that you only needed 51 votes for anything other than a Supreme Court nominee.
Then, of course, now even for Supreme Court nominees, it is only 51.
And don't even get me started on what Chuck Schumer would do to the legislative filibuster.

This rescissions package reflects President Trump's promise that the American Government will, once again, serve the American people, not the other way around.
We cannot accept a system that forces us to fund our own decline.
I urge my colleagues to join me in voting yes on this package.

sentences: Mr. President, I rise today for National Police Week to honor the courageous men and women of law enforcement in Missouri and across our great country.

I backed tougher sentencing rules, fought anti-police policies pushed by city officials, led the charge to secure more boots on the ground for our police in St. Louis, and launched the Safer Streets Initiative, partnering with Federal prosecutors to go after violent criminals in Missouri's most dangerous neighborhoods.
When I ran for the Senate, I was proud to be endorsed by the Fraternal Order of Police, and I have worked every day to make good on the trust our law enforcement officers have placed in me.

Last month, I introduced the Public Safety Free Speech Act to defend the First Amendment rights of our police and our firefighters and our first responders who had been disciplined, suspended, or even fired for their political speech.
Police and other first responders have been fired or suspended for criticizing Black Lives Matter, voicing support for President Trump, or even donating $25 to Kyle Rittenhouse's defense fund.
Those who would assault or kill police officers and first responders should know that they will face swift and devastating justice.
It is no coincidence that the radicals who seek to dismantle our civilization have our law enforcement officers in their crosshairs.

In the wake of that tragedy, I announced that I will be working with our brave firefighters here in Washington, DC, and around the country and other first responder groups to introduce a bill to increase Federal penalties for killing or assaulting first responders.
I will never apologize for standing with those who wear the badge.
